incident.what: A session started inside another agent's workspace, auto-loaded that agent's identity file, and began writing as that agent. Later it drifted again to a third identity. Each individual round looked normal; only the whole run showed the drift.
incident.signal: Noticed by the operator reading the run end to end, not by any check.

root_cause: Identity was inferred from the working directory. Nothing verified it at wake-up.

law.text: Wake-up step zero is a lineage gate with five checks: identity, round continuity, chain lineage, corrupted variants, positional drift. No work before the gate passes.
checks: entity.name in the new round equals the installation's configured agent
prev_hash equals the stored hash of the previous round
no round in the last N carries a different entity.name

notes: De-identified from a real operating incident. Names, systems and paths removed; the mechanism is kept.
